proof: Same source/identity/edge validation still executes at the start of EVERY assess invocation.
Caches exist only inside each synchronous assessment view closure: exact edge-object WeakMap and fixed context; no module/global cache, no timestamp/ID-only cache, no source revision reuse.

The private prepareConditionalQueries function is not exported and cannot be supplied through accessContext. Factory injection is model code only, analogous to existing authoritative validation callbacks.
BFS onboard pattern/index/canAlight state, board/alight checks, sorted edge ID adjacency, first matching target and path arrays retain original algorithm.
Queries reuse only exact (from,to,full-or-ground) results within the same view; each returned path array is copied.
Proof uses the same authoritative memoized eligibility as BFS. Node admission remains independently revalidated with the existing per-assessment nodeProof.
Default queryGraph calls do not use caches and preserve old behavior. Eager all-view evaluation remains unchanged.
Across calls, changed mutable intent reopens to OPEN. Revoked source fails closed by the same original exception; it cannot reuse prior success. Restoring the source triggers a fresh pass.
limits: Benchmark is a small synthetic obligation-multiplicity sample over real two-node source-bound OD, not a national performance forecast. No shared generator/full national replay was run.
Registry hash/full validateEdges and source-independent BFS costs remain; this does not establish that all 790-second runtime is this hotspot.
The temporary benchmark models add counters only; instrumented files are NOT production targets. Only the two candidate targets above may be applied.
Permanent added parity tests should be integrated with existing tracked fixture imports rather than the private benchmark directory.

Noto six-file frozen proposal has an earlier model base; after applying this performance patch, merge/rebase its separate model factory/identity hunks, never overwrite the new model with the whole old Noto private copy. No Noto frozen artifact was changed.
